criteria.requirement: Add exported WeightedMean(value_column, weight_column) and WeightedVariance(value_column, weight_column) aggregations. Both columns must use Number. Operate on same-row pairs, skip a pair if either member is null, reject negative or nonfinite weights and nonfinite values, preserve Decimal arithmetic, and return None for no positive total weight. WeightedVariance is population variance, sum(w*(x-mean)**2)/sum(w), not a sample estimator. Support TableSet aggregation and preserve all existing aggregations.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
